title: Breaking the Binary Theatre doesn’t have an account here BUT THEY SHO...
transcript: there's something really exciting happening in New York this weekend especially if you think that there should be more trans and non binary voices and creatives in the theatre space and that is the breaking the Binary Theatre Festival it is a series of play readings written by trans and non binary playwrights performed by trans and non binary performers and last night I got to attend the reading of The Lady of M Street which is a Macbeth adaptation y'all this was so good I need a full production of it immediately we have seen so many Macbeth adaptations recently and so many of them miss what I feel like is the essence of Macbeth right and I don't mind when adaptations change plot points or are loose adaptations but you still have to have the essence of the original source material the second I found out that the lady of m street was inspired by 1980s soap operas I knew we were in good hands and that it understood what makes Macbeth so great the lady of m street is absolutely the Macbeth adaptation I've been waiting for this adaptation is set in a P t a of an incredibly elite charter school in d C in the 80s and it essentially comes down to these two men and their wives and there's a lot of soapy twists and turns along the way this play was delectable not just the incredible melodrama but also the incredible poetry written by playwright Dane EDidi who also starred in this reading as Lady Macbeth the first stage directions of this play gave me goosebumps the way that she described the darkness that we see to open up the play and how the first scene comes to life breathtaking and especially when you're adapting Shakespeare I think having some sense of poetry to your writing really helps even when it's done in a modern or at least somewhat contemporary setting I have not seen anything by Dana Deedee but she is absolutely a playwright I am watching out for because I I want to see more of her work immediately and this entire cast of trans and non binary artists incredible incredible performers I especially loved the witches uh I went to the reading because SIS is in it and I love her and everything she's done uh but all three of the witches did such a great job of switching back and forth between the the regal persona of the witches and these absolutely hilarious and and unique P t a members in this 1980s world play reading was just so much fun and I cannot wait to eventually see a full production of it I need to see a full production of this and the exciting thing about breaking the Binary Theatre Festival is that they are free to attend they do sell out because the the spaces are small this year it's in Open Jar Studios this is the fourth year they've done these free readings but they're happening through the Sunday October 26th and I think there's still tickets available for the Monologue Showcase on Sunday but even if you're unable to attend any of their work this weekend I highly recommend giving them a follow on socials to find out when they're doing upcoming work because uplifting trans and non binary voices is vital right now and there's so much creativity coming out of theatre and theatre creatives that are often not given the platform to create art and if this is the calibre of the work that they are producing then this is the kind of art that we need more of period period anyway this is great this is great
